title: [Bug 646487] Composite layout: focus fix, body-layout gating, and setup UI
summary: Multiple bugs in composite layout management are fixed, including focus handling, multi-select deletion, configuration key conflicts, and layout subtype restrictions. UI labels are clarified and a Details FactBox replaces the Theme and Header/Footer Box.
key_points: Focus now moves to newly created theme or header/footer parts
Multi-select delete and configuration row creation no longer cause data loss or invalid states
Theme and header/footer can only be assigned to body layouts, enforced at UI and save level
Details FactBox replaces Theme and Header/Footer Box with better layout of information
Configuration row scopes are displayed as human-readable text instead of wildcard conventions
quote: focus not moved to the newly created part.
